description: Adds up to 200 commitments in one call, as one reviewable batch. A recurring row is planned from first_charge for plan_months (24 by default); a one-time row is its single charge on `date`. A statement line that is a charge is a one-time row at its real date and amount with paid: true and basis "statement". Money in — salary, a refund, interest, cashback, a dividend — is a one-time row with direction "in", paid, basis "statement", kept apart from spending. Movements between the owner's own accounts (card bill payments, ATM withdrawals, own transfers) are not charges; a row with direction "transfer" keeps one in view, shown and never summed. A member or account is named in words, and a new name becomes a placeholder row as the app would create it. A tag from the library (any casing) arrives with its icon. `notes` holds a row's three most important details, one per line, such as an insurance policy's number, its official name or its file in documents/. Where writes are proposals, rows can be promoted to recurring once the owner's app has applied the batch. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Proposals screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

guide_key.description: The guide_key read_guide returned with the prompt or chapter this write follows.

amount.description: A number, zero or more, up to 1,000,000,000,000,000.

custom_cycle_days.description: The days between charges of a custom cycle: a whole number, 1 to 36,500.

direction.description: "in" for money that arrives — salary, a refund, interest. "transfer" for a movement between the owner's own accounts they want to see — a card bill due, a standing move to savings. Neither is ever summed with spending.

notes.description: The three details that matter most, one per line, each "Label: value" — for insurance "Policy number: …", "Policy name: …", "Document: documents/…". Only what the source states; read_guide "notes" lists the three by category. Card numbers, whole account numbers and credentials are refused.

plan_count.description: How many charges to write for a recurring commitment, counted from first_charge — 240 at most. When given, plan_months is not read.
